question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word in the context of the passage.

Consumption
solution:
The correct answer is **"Creation". **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given word **"Consumption" **refers to the using up of a resource. **(उपभोग.)**

 
 
• **Example: **The consumption of electricity in our house increases during summer due to the use of air conditioners.
 
 
 
• The correct antonym **"Creation" **refers to the act of bringing something into existence. **(सृजन.)**
 
 
• **Example: **The creation of art can be a therapeutic process for many people.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is- Option 4.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Depletion **is the reduction in the number or quantity of something. **(कमी). **

 
 
• **Example: **The depletion of natural resources is a serious environmental concern.
 
 
 
• **Elation **is a feeling of great joy or pride. **(उत्साह).**
 
 
• **Example: **She felt a sense of elation when she completed the marathon.
 
 
 
• **Utilisation **means making practical and effective use of something. **(उपयोग).**
 
 
• **Example: **The utilisation of solar energy can reduce our dependence on fossil fuels.
